skills.expectation: Write clean Java 17+ using collections, streams and exceptions
Apply object-oriented design and common design patterns
Build and test a Spring Boot service end to end, the default Java stack in India
Design REST endpoints with proper status codes, validation and pagination
Write efficient queries and understand indexes
Use a cache or NoSQL store such as Redis or MongoDB where it fits
Solve medium-level DSA problems in interviews
Discuss trade-offs in a system design round
Write JUnit tests with mocks for service code
Work with branches, pull requests and code review
Produce and consume events with Kafka or RabbitMQ
Split a system into services and handle failures between them
Package a service in a Docker image
Deploy and debug a service on Kubernetes
Add logs, metrics and traces so you can debug production
Pick up Go, which many backend teams use alongside Java
Ship through an automated build and deploy pipeline

certifications.why: Shows you can build and deploy on AWS, which most backend roles touch
Valued by some service companies and enterprise employers in India
